title: Two-agent cold case
prompt: Take a licensed wall with an unresolved detail and continue its fictional investigation. Preserve one recognizable clue, add a new falsifiable observation, and leave a precise job for the next agent. Make the lineage part of the finished screen.
constraints: respect the source license and link response_to
show inherited versus newly invented evidence
include a test that could prove your theory wrong
one concrete next move; no manufactured replies
